verdicts.reason: DFU FactionFile.cs:537-538: Subgroup=3, Individual=4; StaticNPC.cs:319 tests type==(int)Individual(4). Port's staticNpc.js:220 sets FACTION_TYPE_INDIVIDUAL=3, used at :209 - checks Subgroup not Individual. Port's own faction dict and quest code (questMacros.js:321,365; actions.js:2340,2412) correctly use 4 elsewhere, confirming staticNpc.js is the outlier. Both cited test pins mock type:3 as 'individual', restating the bug.

DFU StaticNPC.cs:309 always sets npcData.nameBank = GetNameBankOfCurrentRegion() before GetDisplayName (:325-326) uses it - region-based, never race-based. Port's staticNpcName (staticNpc.js:206,211) defaults to bankForRace(data.race); its only two callers (worldModes.js:976,1364) never pass nameBank. Port already has getNameBankOfRegion wired for mobile NPCs (world.js:506) but never for static NPCs - an unported gap, not a departure.

worldModes.js:1363 calls staticNpcData(pn, {...questSceneCtx(), buildingKey}) with no getFaction/raceOfCurrentRegion, so raceFromFaction's fallback (staticNpc.js:139-141) always yields Nord. The direct-click seam (worldModes.js:890) instead uses questBridge.clickNpc, which adds npcRaceLookups() (questBridge.js:237-239,256-259) with real lookups off ctx.world - matching DFU's single unconditional GetRaceFromFaction (StaticNPC.cs:357-369). No test pin covers this omission.

worldModes.js:979/1366 pass targetNPC={data:pn,...} where pn (from interiorPeople.js:30-48) has no nameSeed field; the real derived nameSeed is computed separately and used only for displayName. npcSession.js:467 reads targetNPC?.data?.nameSeed??0, always 0, so isCastleNpcOfferingQuest keys castleNPCsSpokenTo by 0 (npcSession.js:564-573) vs DFU's per-NPC targetNPC.Data.nameSeed (TalkManager.cs:769). audit24_onehome.test.js:225 pins the exact buggy shape.

collectExteriorNpcs (exteriorNpcs.js:12-14) correctly ports RMBLayout.cs:365-378's non-zero-FactionID rule, but grep of exterior.js/world.js for 'factionID' returns zero hits; only test/names.test.js imports it. test/audit18_bible_docs.test.js:337-338 pins the Port-Ledger.md line documenting this exact known no-caller gap, confirming it, not refuting.

DFU gates both questor arms on IsChildNPC (TalkManager.cs:755,769 -> StaticNPC.cs:342-350: texture table or factionID==514). Port reads isChildNPC/isChild at worldModes.js:979,1366 and npcSession.js:466,653 but writes it nowhere - pn never carries it, staticNpc.js has neither the 514 constant nor a child-texture table, so it's always false and the !isChildNPC guards (npcSession.js:468,472) never exclude a child. audit24_onehome.test.js:225 pins the always-false `!!pn.isChildNPC` shape verbatim.

C#: KnockbackMovement sets CanAct=false whenever KnockbackSpeed>0 (EnemyMotor.cs:272-317); TakeAction (incl. DoRangedAttack:469/DoTouchSpell:473) runs only `if(CanAct)` (:171-172). C#: HandleNoAction (EnemyMotor.cs:357-366) resets searchMult=0 on all 3 arms (target null, GiveUpTimer<=0, sentinel), every FixedUpdate. C#: FixedUpdate calls UpdateTimers unconditionally (EnemyMotor.cs:170) before `if(CanAct) TakeActionHandler()` (:171-172); UpdateTimers (:389-425) refills/decrements GiveUpTimer with no paralysis/knockback/CanAct check. WeaponManager.SetWeapon (WeaponManager.cs:769-781) sets DrawWeaponSound=weapon.GetEquipSound() for any real weapon (SetMelee, fists-only, is the sole path keeping the default). GetEquipSound (DaggerfallUnityItem.cs:820-869) returns per-type clips absent from the port's SOUND enum. Port's toggleSheath (weaponRig.js:102-105) unconditionally plays SOUND.DrawWeapon(78). test/weaponrig.test.js:31-37 pins this exact wrong behavior with no C# citation.

WeaponManager.Update does `if (Time.time < cooldownTime) return;` (WeaponManager.cs:227-230) before any ShowWeapons call, so the prior shown=true state persists through bow cooldown. Port's shown() explicitly returns false during cooldown (weaponRig.js:75, `m.isBow && m.now < m.cooldownUntil`), and draw() gates on shown() (weaponRig.js:131-136). Confirmed blink-out divergence.

WeaponManager.Update hides weapons during equip countdown: `if (EquipCountdown...!=0) { ShowWeapons(false); return; }` (WeaponManager.cs:272-278). Port's shown() (weaponRig.js:71-77) never checks entity.equipCountdown, while attackInput/clickAttack (96,100) and frame()'s drain (116-119, dt*980 matching :688) do. equip.js:56 confirms equipCountdown is set on every equip, so draw() renders the weapon through the silent-block pause.

AcrobatMotor.HandleJumpInput:76 bypasses the grounded-time gate via `!climbingMotor.WasClimbing`, WasClimbing set true the frame climbing ends (ClimbingMotor.cs:92-95,390). Port's motor.js:649 gate has no such bypass, and groundedTime resets to 0 whenever ungrounded (motor.js:508), so it's 0 right after landing from a climb. climbing.js:119 writes this.wasClimbing every step; grep of src/ and test/ finds zero readers - a ported field with no consumer.

LevitateMotor.cs:83-89 computes overEncumbered=(CarriedWeight*4>250)&&!levitating&&!GodMode and, when swimming+overEncumbered+not climbing+not water-walking, forces upDownVector=down (replacing the Jump/Crouch arms via if/else-if). motor.js:520-531 (_step) computes my purely from input.up/input.down with no encumbrance term at all, and no host or system file (grepped src/ for CarriedWeight/encumb) feeds carried weight into the swim path. An over-encumbered swimmer in the port floats/surfaces freely; DFU forces them down and blocks the float keys.

PlayerHeightChanger.DecideHeightAction:137-145 forces DoStanding and returns when levitating+crouching, and the crouch-press arm is gated by `else if (!riding && !onWater && !levitating)` at :171, so Crouch does nothing while levitating in DFU. motor.js's _heightAction (352-368) has exactly three arms (crouch-press, swim-force, swim-unforce) with no `levitating` term anywhere in the file (grep confirms `this.levitating` is only read in _step's movement branch, never in _heightAction), so the crouch toggle fires unconditionally while levitating and a crouched levitator is never forced to stand.

PlayerHeightChanger.DecideHeightAction:184-191 has an `else if (climbing) { ... if (crouching) heightAction = DoStanding; ... }` arm that forces a crouched climber to stand. motor.js's _heightAction (352-368) has no climbing check at all (grep for `this.crouching =` shows only the crouch-press/swim/collider-fit sites), and _climbStep (motor.js ~480-501) never reads or clears `this.crouching`. A crouched climber in the port stays crouched through and after the climb.

LevitateMotor.Update:71-91 moves via camera pitch, reading Jump/FloatUp and Crouch/FloatDown for vertical. motor.js's levitate branch needs up/down plus pitch. exterior.js:1482-1489 and world.js:3135-3142 call player.update(dt,{...,crouch}, cam.yaw): no up/down keys, no pitch (defaults 0). shared.js:379-384 applyMotorEffectFlags, called by both outdoor hosts, sets player.levitating from the active effect each frame regardless of location. With pitch=0 and up/down undefined, vertical velocity is always 0 outdoors.

LevitateMotor.Update:86-89 sets the down arm from HasAction(Crouch)||HasAction(FloatDown). Both hosts that wire up/down (dungeon.js:401, worldModes.js:2661) use only `down: held(keys,'FloatDown')`, never Crouch, while their up arms correctly OR jumpHeld/FloatUp. Outdoor hosts pass no down key at all (F030). Holding Crouch alone never dives/descends in any port host, though DFU's Crouch key does.

AcrobatMotor.ApplyGravity:187 assigns moveDirection.y=-105*Time.deltaTime, then PlayerGroundMotor.cs:86 applies controller.Move(moveDirection*Time.deltaTime), giving real displacement 105*dt^2/step = 105*dt m/s = 2.1 m/s at DFU's Fixed Timestep 0.02 (TimeManager.asset:6). motor.js reproduces the same double-dt shape (velY=-SLOWFALL_SPEED*dt at ~670, then dy=velY*dt) but FIXED_DT=1/60 (motor.js:73) yields 105/60=1.75 m/s. The pin motorStairs.test.js:295 asserts exactly -SLOWFALL_SPEED/60, restating the port's own rate rather than refuting the gap.

townTalk.js:282 calls `randomVariant(FOUND_NOTHING_VALUABLE_TEXT_ID,...)`, a SubrecordSeparator-variant picker (:171-174). dungeonContext.js:26 imports the real 3-arg hurtPlayer as hurtEntity, but :1030-1032 locally redefines hurtPlayer(dmg) (1 arg), shadowing it file-wide. dungeonContext.js:691-696 assigns spells/casters in a ONE-TIME loop over `foes` run once during setup, after the load loop (:623); buildFoeAt itself (:479-622, read in full) never calls assignEnemySpells or mints EnemyCaster. spawnQuestFoe (:630-636) and _spawnEncounter (:913-928) push new records via buildFoeAt AFTER that one-time loop, so late-spawned foes never get spells; frame loop's cast check (:2312, f.caster&&...) is always false for them. world.js:623 and exterior.js:401 pass `enemiesNearby: (cityGuards?.activeCount?.() ?? 0) > 0` into exhaustionOutcome - only guards, exteriorFoes never consulted.
